  PERMITS AND LICENSES COMMITTEE
  MINUTES
  July 25, 2024

A meeting of the Permits and License Committee was conducted as a Call-In at 1-669-900-6833, meeting
ID 982 4253 6876 and Password 828281 on July 25, 2024 at 2:00 pm.

Roll Call:  Members Present:  Harjinder Singh, Administration
  Christine Rivera, Planning Department
  Cpt. Reggie Johnson, Los Angeles County Fire Department
  Sgt. Luis Jaramillo, Inglewood Police Department – 2:16 pm
  Raul Fernandez, Public Works Department
  Boytrese Osias, Public Works Department
  Jazmine Covington, Emergency Service & Public Safety Department

  Staff Present:  Angela Allen, City Clerk’s Office
  Mayra Toro, Finance Department
  Ruben Rodriguez, Finance department

Public Comments Regarding Agenda Items
During public comments any person may address the Permits & License Committee, provided the item is
within the subject matter jurisdiction of the Permits & License Committee.

Chairman Singh asked if there were any persons present who wished to address the Permits & License
Committee on any item on the Agenda.

Chairman Singh reported that there were no public requests to speak.

Approval of the minutes of the meeting held on July 11, 2024

Permit(s):
Item #1:  Cinder Eller Kimbell on behalf of Inglewood Police Department to host an Inglewood Police
  Department National Night Out 2024 Event on Grevillea Ave. between Queen St. and
  Regent St., Public Property, on Tuesday, August 06, 2024 from 5:00 p.m. – 8:30 p.m.
  APPROVED CONDITIONALLY SUBJECT TO THE FOLLOWING STIPULATIONS:
  Applicant changed start time from 6:00 pm to 5:00 pm; Applicant to adhere to
  recommendations outlined by the Planning Department / Inglewood Police Department;
  Approval for 1 day event on Grevillea Ave. Subject to Public Works approval for use/closure
  of the right of way; Officers/ personnel will be at event, (3) TCO’s will be deployed for street
  closures; Maintain site at all times, ensuring site is properly cleaned immediately at the end
  of the event; Applicant and staff members working this event shall follow all social
  distancing, protective personal hygiene and face mask wearing safety guidelines set forth
  by the LA.CO. Health Department and CA State health department; and Adhere to all State,
  Federal, LA County, and applicable Inglewood Municipal Code rules and regulations,
  including noise and signage. Motion carried unanimously (Activity No. 00384931)
 Permits & License Committee  July 25, 2024
Minutes  Page 2 of 4

Item #2:  Doris Obih on behalf of 40 Love Foundation to host a Field Day Event at 700 Warren Ln.,
  Edward Vincent Jr. Park, Public Property, on Saturday, August 10,2024, from 10:00 a.m. –
  3:00 p.m. APPLICANT CANCELED EVENT: (Activity No. 00384957)

Item #3:  Dionne Faulk on behalf of The City of Inglewood to host a Back to School Backpack
  Giveaway Event at 11200 Crenshaw Blvd., Crenshaw Shopping Center, Private Property,
  on Saturday, August 24, 2024 from 10:00 a.m. – 12:00 p.m. APPROVED
  CONDITIONALLY SUBJECT TO THE FOLLOWING STIPULATIONS: Inglewood Police
  Department to provide (2) police officers for public safety and (4) TCO’s for traffic safety;
  Any staff working the parking lot shall wear reflective vests for risk management; Adhere
  to all local, state and federal laws.Maintain site at all times, ensuring site is properly cleaned
  immediately at the end of the event; Applicant and staff members working this event shall
  follow all social distancing, protective personal hygiene and face mask wearing safety
  guidelines set forth by the LA.CO. Health Department and CA State health department;
  and Adhere to all State, Federal, LA County, and applicable Inglewood Municipal Code
  rules and regulations, including noise and signage. Motion carried unanimously (Activity
  No. 00384943)
New Business License Request (s):

Item #4:  Sami Nomair DBA Citiguard Security Inc. to operate as a Guard Service at City of
  Inglewood APPROVED CONDITIONALLY SUBJECT TO THE FOLLOWING
  STIPULATIONS: Payment of annual business license and tax fees; Maintain valid and current
  Private Patrol Operator License from the Department of Consumer Affairs, Bureau of Security
  and Investigative Services; Security Guards must be licensed with the Department of Consumer
  Affairs, Bureau of Security and Investigative Services; Business owner/facility is strictly
  prohibited from hiring or employing any person registered under California Penal Code
  Section 290 PC or any person that may pose a public safety risk/threat to patients or other
  employees at the location; and Adhere to all State, Federal and Inglewood Municipal Code
  rules and regulations, including noise and signage. Failure to comply with any of the
  aforementioned will result in the revocation of your business license and any future
  business license application requests. Motion carried unanimously (Activity No.
  00384943)

Item #5:  Althea Bridges DBA Really Raw to operate as a Hair/ Nail Salon at 921 N. La Brea Ave.;
  APPROVED CONDTIONALLY SUBJECT TO THE FOLLOWING STIPULATIONS:
  Payment of annual business license and tax fees; Business owner must possess and
  maintain valid and current Establishment License from the State Board of Barbering &
  Cosmetology; Cosmetologist’s, Barbers, Esthetician's and Manicurists operating within the
  establishment must possess applicable licenses from the State Board of Barbering &
  Cosmetology; Cosmetologist's, Barbers, Esthetician's and Manicurists operating within the
  establishment is required to register and file business tax with the City; Business owner
  shall provide valid and current government-issued identification and copies of applicable
  state licensing on all employee(s) and/or any person operating within the establishment to
 Permits & License Committee  July 25, 2024

  the Finance Department; Parties, social events or gatherings of any type is strictly
  prohibited; Consumption of alcoholic beverages, narcotic drug use (including cannabis
  activity) is not permitted on the premises. Massage therapy of any part of the body is not
  permitted; Subject to random inspections by any City Code Enforcement Officer or any
  Peace Officer at any time to ensure compliance; Adhere to all State, Federal and Inglewood
  Municipal Code rules and regulations, including noise and signage. Failure to comply with
  any of the aforementioned will result in the revocation of your business license and
  any future business license application requests. Motion carried unanimously (Activity
  No. 00384949)

Item #6:  Nega Fechisso DBA VPNE Parking Solutions LLC to operate as a Parking Lot at 9920 La
  Cienega Blvd.; Item held over until further notice; (Activity No. 00384879)

Item #7:  Tyrell Goodman DBA Sportz Fanz 760 LLC to operate as a Sidewalk Vendor at the corner
  of E. Buckthorn and S. Prairie Ave.; Item held over until further notice; (Activity No.

Held over from 07.11.24:
Item #8:  Milton D. Carranza DBA Leon Valet Parking to operate as a Parking Lot at 162 N. LA Brea
  Ave.; APPROVED CONDITIONALLY SUBJECT TO THE FOLLOWING STIPULATIONS:
  Payment of annual business license and tax fees, an expired or lapsed license for more
  than six month will negatively impact your license renewal; Remittances of Parking Tax by
  the 20th of each month following collection; Approval for Special Event Parking Forum
  events only; Special Event Parking must not start before 6 pm Monday through Friday; On
  Site business must be closed 1 hour before Event Parking starts. Parking attendant or
  security guards must be on site during event parking at all times; Ensure safe pedestrian
  and vehicular circulation on/off site and; Adhere to all State, Federal and Inglewood
  Municipal Code rules and regulations, including noise and signage. Failure to comply with
  any of the aforementioned will result in revocation of your business license and any
  future license application requests. Motion carried unanimously (Activity No. 00384540)
